name: blumac-korean-store
description: Model Context Protocol server for BLUMAC Korean Store - Search authentic Korean skincare products, check stock, verify prices in INR, and track orders across India.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Korean skincare catalog by product name, active ingredient, brand or category in India.

query.description: Search term, e.g. snail mucin, sunscreen, centella, toner

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (default: 10)

tools.name: get_product_price_and_stock
tools.description: Get current selling price, MRP, discount percentage, and real-time inventory status in Indian Rupees (INR).

tools.name: check_pincode_serviceability
tools.description: Check BlueDart & Delhivery courier delivery SLA and COD availability for an Indian 6-digit PIN code.
